integrity: The determinant identity is derived from the source's printed equilibrium and Jacobian formulas. The proof is analytic; the bundled checker only replays the algebra on representative positive parameter sets.
scientific_limitations: The result is local and does not establish global convergence to the coexistence equilibrium.
The additional sufficient hypotheses in the source's Li-Muldowney global-stability theorem are not shown to be automatic.
The no-Hopf consequence is specific to the printed continuous-time model.
title: The coexistence equilibrium in a four-stage date-palm-mite model is always locally stable above threshold
